findings.F1: A coin's 7-day return measured in units of its 30-day mean absolute daily return predicts its next 10 days, and the effect is graded at the top: on non-overlapping 240-hour cells, the top fifth of that measure is followed by an unusual move of +4.49 % (t 3.44, 278 cases, strength 0.27), the fourth fifth by +0.20 % (t 0.25), and the bottom three fifths by -1.23 %, -1.92 % and -1.57 % (t -1.5 to -2.2). Top minus bottom is positive in all 6 coins (Spearman 0.03 to 0.15, BTC and ETH p 0.02) and in 6 of 8 years (2022 and 2023 negative).
findings.F2: The same continuation shows over 4 days and only when the 30-day return is positive. On 96-hour cells, the top fifth of the 7-day measure gives +1.86 % unusual move (t 3.73, 508 cases) when the 30-day return is positive, against +0.06 % (t 0.09, 229 cases) when it is not. Over all coins, the top fifth gives +1.30 % (t 3.22, 737 cases).
findings.F3: The tested idea's own deep 24-hour fall carries little of its result. Falls below -2 usual daily moves are followed by +0.25 % unusual move over 4 days (t 0.33, 220 cases) and +0.18 % over 10 days (t 0.19, 210 cases). Only the 17 cases below -3 usual moves with a positive 30-day return show +8.1 % (t 3.08), too few to stand apart from chance after this many angles.
findings.F4: A 24-hour rise larger than 2 usual daily moves is followed by an unusual move of +3.43 % over the next 10 days (t 2.28, 248 cases) and +1.23 % over 4 days (t 1.64, 258 cases). This matches the brief's breakout, but on the long side rather than after a plunge.
findings.F5: The book is carried by trades held far beyond the 4-day horizon: the median trade lasts 219 hours. The longest quarter of trades (median 822 hours) earns +23.8 % mean and +11.7 % median after fees, against +0.10 % for the shortest quarter (median 5 hours) and -3.2 % for the second quarter (median 130 hours).
findings.F6: The hours 20 and 21 UTC rise on every coin, by +4.2 to +5.5 bps per hour (t 3.0 to 4.4 per coin, about 5,800 bars each), in 7 of 8 years (2022 at -2.2 bps). Over all 24 hours tested, hour 20 stands out at t 6.7. The move is far below the 19 bps a round trip cost here, so it is not a book on its own.
findings.F7: A 4-day cell starting on a Saturday ends +1.72 % above the drift (t 4.02, 433 cases), and the result is positive in 5 of 6 coins. It is negative in 2018 and 2019 (t -1.45 and -0.65) and carried by 2020 to 2022, so it does not stand apart from a period effect among 7 weekdays tested.

ideas.idea: When a coin's 30-day return is positive, the larger its 7-day return in units of its 30-day mean absolute daily return, the more its price rises over the next 10 days above its usual 10-day drift.
ideas.consequence: A strong week, measured against the coin's usual daily move, in a coin already rising over the month, is a reason to buy and hold for about 10 days, and the stronger the week, the stronger the case.
ideas.name: strong week continues uptrend

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 24-hour rise in units of its 30-day mean absolute daily return, the more its price rises over the next 10 days above its usual 10-day drift.
ideas.consequence: A one-day surge several times the coin's usual daily move, caught at the hour it forms, is a reason to buy for about 10 days rather than to fade it.
ideas.name: one-day surge keeps rising
